obfuscation_indicators: may not know the full effect
risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial operational and financial quantification, including segment revenues, cost percentages, client counts, and margin changes. Key risks include dependence on clients exposed to Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement, volatile labor and commodity costs, potential inability to pass through cost increases, and regulatory uncertainty. The extensive boilerplate and truncated discussion modestly limit clarity regarding the magnitude and timing of adverse impacts.
